title: 6 women among 15 lawyers designated by J&K High Court as Senior Advocates
description: The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh has elevated 15 advocates, including 6 women, as Senior Advocates.The designation takes effect from May 22.The advocates designated as Senior Advocates are:1.
